purpose: PM REVIEW #2 R1/R2: canonical planning ranks COMPLETE (outgoing exit, incoming entry, pair compatibility AT that boundary) plans, never an outgoing exit selected in isolation with pair compatibility applied only afterward.

TX-01.title: boundary_ranking_pair_compat_overrides_raw_structure
TX-01.purpose: R1: pair compatibility must participate in boundary ranking, not be applied only after the timing/structure winner is already fixed.

TX-02.title: incoming_entry_zero_ms_correct
TX-02.purpose: Incoming entry case A: starting at 0ms is genuinely correct; a later point with no evidence must be rejected.

TX-03.title: incoming_entry_leading_silence_skip
TX-03.purpose: Incoming entry case B: authored non-musical leading silence may be skipped; meaningful intro must not be silently removed.

TX-04.title: incoming_entry_later_phrase_better_than_zero
TX-04.purpose: Incoming entry case C: a later phrase/downbeat/cue entry is clearly a better transition entry than 0ms.

TX-05.title: incoming_entry_choice_changes_compatibility
TX-05.purpose: Incoming entry case D: which entry candidate is chosen changes vocal/structure compatibility at that specific boundary.

TX-06.title: incoming_entry_zero_ms_explicit_beat_downbeat_anchor
TX-06.purpose: R5 (PM REVIEW #3) case B: 0ms is a valid incoming entry AND is explicitly authored as a beat/downbeat anchor -- FULL_DJ_BLEND MAY remain eligible when every other hard gate passes (contrast with TX-02, case A, where 0ms has no anchor and FULL_DJ_BLEND must be withheld).

TX-07.title: preservation_safety_band_ranking_1p00_incompatible_vs_0p99_compatible
TX-07.purpose: R8 (PM REVIEW #3) required mutation: OUT-A (preservation exactly 1.00, pair-incompatible) vs OUT-B (preservation exactly 0.99, pair-compatible) -- both in the PREFERRED band (>=0.97). Canonical planner must select B, the better COMPLETE boundary, not A merely because of the +0.01 raw preservation edge. OUT-C (0.94, compatible) and OUT-D (0.85, compatible) are both BELOW the 0.95 default floor and must never even reach the eligible set, regardless of compatibility -- proving the hard floor cannot be crossed by compatibility.

tx01_order_invariance.note: TX-01: OUT-A has the higher raw outgoing-only structure score but every boundary touching it is pair-incompatible (HIGH vocal collision); OUT-B is pair-compatible. The winner must be OUT-B+IN-2 (best compatible + best combined structure) under every outgoing-array and incoming-array ordering.
